components.name: Paper
components.description: Torn sheet of paper with a white rim - the core surface for heroes, sections and cards.
components.notes: Pick `edge` by size: `big-*` for large sheets, `card-*` for cards, `chip-*` for small bits, one-sided edges (`top-*`, `bottom-*`, `foot-*`, `l-*`, `r-*`) for strips that touch something. Colours: paper, pink, butter, mint, sky, lilac, notebook.
components.example:
import { Paper } from 'paperpop';
lilac

edge big-1

 butter

edge card-2

 mint

edge card-3

 sky

edge card-4

 pink

edge card-5

 paper

edge big-2

props.name: color
props.description: Fill colour of the sheet. "notebook" draws ruled lines with a margin.

props.name: flat
props.description: Drop the shadow, e.g. for sheets lying on other sheets.

props.name: pad
props.description: Inner padding (number = px). Without it the CSS variable --pad applies (default 32px), so pages can change it per breakpoint.

components.name: Washi
components.description: Strips of washi tape in several prints - stick them on polaroids, cards and notes.
components.example: import { Washi } from 'paperpop';

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in the text flow instead of absolutely positioned.

components.name: Polaroid
components.description: Polaroid frame with handwritten caption, optional tape and corner tag - for photos or placeholders.
components.example:
import { Icon, PixelHeart, Polaroid } from 'paperpop';
J

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Without it the photo area shows a striped placeholder (or `children`).

props.name: width
props.description: Frame width (number = px). Without it the frame uses the CSS variable --pw (default 300px).

props.name: tape
props.description: Stick a piece of washi tape on top: `true` for a centered strip, or Washi props to place it yourself.

props.name: color2
props.description: Override the second (lighter) stripe colour, any CSS colour.

props.name: tag
props.description: Small ink tag in the top right corner of the photo.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom photo content (icon, big letter, anything).

components.name: StickyNote
components.description: Sticky note with a peeling corner (lifts further on hover), pinned with a pushpin or tape.
components.example:
import { Marker, StickyNote } from 'paperpop';
Milch kaufen und die Welt retten. Nicht vergessen: Pause machen ♥ Normaler Text

geht auch ohne Marker-Schrift. Fahr mit der Maus über die Ecke.

props.name: pin
props.description: Stick it on with a pushpin instead of tape.

props.name: tape
props.description: Stick it on with washi tape.

components.name: TodoList
components.description: Static handwritten to-do list with drawn boxes and pink ticks - best on a StickyNote.
components.notes: For a list people can tick off, use `Checklist` (Apps).
components.example:
import { StickyNote, TodoList } from 'paperpop';
GERADE SO

props.name: items
props.description: Entries; `done` ones get a pink tick and are struck through.

components.name: LabelTags
components.description: Label-maker (Dymo) tags for skills, tools and categories.
components.example: import { LabelTags } from 'paperpop';

props.name: items
props.description: Tags as strings or objects with colour/tilt. Colours cycle through the palette by default.

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Rubber stamp that thumps onto the page - success states, "sent!", "sold out".

props.name: note
props.description: Small handwritten line under the stamp text.

props.name: show
props.description: Controls visibility; toggling it to true plays the "thump" animation.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Center it absolutely over the parent (like a "sent!" overlay).

components.name: Sticker
components.description: Round, burst or star sticker for "NEU!" labels - wiggles on hover or spins slowly.
components.example:
import { Sticker } from 'paperpop';
Neu! -20% Top Hi!

props.name: spin
props.description: Spin slowly all the time instead of only on hover.

components.name: Marker
components.description: Marks inline text with a highlighter, scribbled underline, circle, strike or washi tape - drawn in on view.
components.example:
import { Marker } from 'paperpop';

Ich bin Entwickler, baue Webseiten und {' '}Apps, war nie ohne Pläne und {' '}klebe gern Tape auf alles.

props.name: onView
props.description: Draw the mark when it scrolls into view (instead of immediately).

components.name: Doodle
components.description: Hand-drawn arrows, circles, squiggles, stars and hearts that draw themselves in.
components.example: import { Doodle } from 'paperpop';

props.name: size
props.description: Width in px, height follows the doodle's aspect ratio.

components.name: Cutline
components.description: Dashed "cut here" divider - click it and the scissors snip along the line.
components.notes: Click anywhere on the line to cut. With `onView` it cuts once by itself when it scrolls into view (the Footer does this).
components.example:
import { Cutline } from 'paperpop';

<Cutline label="hier abschneiden" style={{ margin: 0 }} />

props.name: label
props.description: Optional handwritten note at the end of the line.

props.name: onView
props.description: Cut once by itself when it scrolls into view. Clicking always cuts.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Chunky display headings in five sizes plus the handwritten Kicker line.
components.example:
import { Heading, Kicker, Marker } from 'paperpop';
hi, schön dass du da bist ♥ Ich bin Jack. Eine Zwischenüberschrift

Fließtext in IBM Plex Mono, Notizen in Marker, Labels in Caps.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size, independent from the level.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of a trailing accent like the pink dot in "Jack.".

components.name: Notebook
components.description: Ruled notebook page with a red margin line - long text sits on the lines.
components.example:
import { Notebook } from 'paperpop';

Was ich gelernt habe

Ein Server mit 110 Spielern zeigt dir schnell, was du noch nicht weißt. Und dass Freundschaften länger halten als jede Map.

props.name: margin
props.description: Distance of the red margin line from the left (px). Default 70, 40 on small screens.

props.name: line
props.description: Line height of the ruling (px). Text snaps to it.

props.name: holes
props.description: Punch holes along the left edge.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Chunky line icon set (plus filled heart, sparkle, star) and the DVN pixel heart.
components.notes: All icon names are exported as `ICON_NAMES`. Icons inherit `color`; pass `label` to make an icon meaningful for screen readers.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden).

components.name: PaperPopEffects
components.description: Page effects: sparkles on every click and washi tape text selection. Mount once at the app root.
components.notes: Also available as plain functions: `installSparkles()`, `installWashiSelection()` (both return an uninstall function) and `burstSparkles(x, y)`. Everything respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
components.example:
import { PaperPopEffects, StickyNote } from 'paperpop';
Klick irgendwo hin ✦ und markier mal Text.

props.name: washiSelection
props.description: Washi tape text selection on desktop.

components.name: TitleTypewriter
components.description: Types the browser tab title: the old one is deleted back to the shared beginning, the new one is typed out.
components.notes: Mount once at the app root. Pass `title` to set it directly, or leave it out to animate titles that a framework sets (e.g. Next metadata) - the whole `<head>` is observed because frameworks replace the `<title>` element. Plain function: `installTitleTypewriter(options)` returns an uninstall function. Background tabs and `prefers-reduced-motion` skip the animation.

props.name: title
props.description: Sets the tab title (and types it). Leave out to animate titles set elsewhere, e.g. by a framework's metadata.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Block shown at the end while the title moves. Empty string for none.

props.name: settle
props.description: Milliseconds the title must stay unchanged before typing starts, so quick successive changes only animate the last one.

components.name: Confetti
components.description: Paper confetti burst - fire it on success moments by changing a counter.
components.notes: Imperative version: `burstConfetti(x, y, count)` with viewport coordinates.

props.name: fire
props.description: Change this value (e.g. increment a counter) to fire another burst. 0 never fires.

components.name: Button
components.description: The chunky, slightly crooked main button with a hard ink shadow. Colours, sizes, icons, loading, link mode.
components.example: import { Button } from 'paperpop';

props.name: tilt
props.description: Rotation in degrees - the slightly crooked look.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinning sparkle and disables the button.

components.name: Pill
components.description: Outlined rounded secondary button for navigation, filters and secondary actions.
components.example:
import { Pill } from 'paperpop';
der name projekte Filter klein aus

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the pill as selected / current page.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Round icon-only button with an optional counter badge.
components.example: import { IconButton } from 'paperpop';

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label (required - there is no visible text).

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: Connected toggle buttons for switching views (Tag / Woche / Monat).

props.name: options
props.type: Array<T | { value: T; label: ReactNode; icon?: IconName }>
props.description: Options as values or { value, label, icon }.

components.name: Fab
components.description: Floating action button - a big round sticker that wiggles for attention.
components.example: import { Fab } from 'paperpop';

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; also shown as a handwritten hint when `hint` is set.

props.name: hint
props.description: Show the label as a handwritten note next to the button.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Stick to the bottom right corner of the viewport.

components.name: CopyButton
components.description: Copies text to the clipboard and flips to "Kopiert!" for two seconds.
components.example:
import { CopyButton } from 'paperpop';

<CopyButton text="curl -L iamjustjack.de" label="Befehl kopieren" />

props.name: text
props.description: Text that goes to the clipboard.

components.name: LikeButton
components.description: Heart button: a pink wave floods the whole button and sparkles fly across it when liked.
components.example: import { LikeButton } from 'paperpop';

props.name: liked
props.description: Current like state (controlled). Leave undefined to let the button manage itself.

props.name: count
props.description: Like count before the user's own like.

components.name: SocialLinks
components.description: Small chip links for social profiles and contact channels.
components.notes: Without `items` it shows Jack's real channels from links.iamjustjack.de (`JACK_SOCIALS`). Entries with `copy` instead of `href` copy a handle, e.g. a Discord name.
components.example:
import { SocialLinks } from 'paperpop';

<SocialLinks />

props.name: items
props.description: Links with icon; entries with `copy` instead of `href` copy a handle.

components.name: Field
components.description: Label, input and hint/error in one - wires id and aria attributes automatically.
components.example: import { Field, Input } from 'paperpop';

props.name: label
props.description: Label text (small caps above the input).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message - replaces the hint and marks the input invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds a pink asterisk to the label.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input: ink underline on paper ("line") or a bordered box for apps ("box").
components.example: import { Input } from 'paperpop';

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the input: underlined (on paper) or boxed (in apps/dashboards).

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line input that writes on ruled notebook lines.
components.example:
import { Textarea } from 'paperpop';

<Textarea placeholder="Hey Jack, …" defaultValue={'Hey Jack,\nich hätte da eine Idee …'} />

props.name: ruled
props.description: Ruled notebook lines behind the text.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Hand-drawn checkbox with a pink tick that draws itself.
components.example: import { Checkbox } from 'paperpop';

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Round hand-drawn radio buttons, vertical or inline.

props.name: options
props.description: Options as values or { value, label }.

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off toggle with a bouncy knob.
components.example: import { Switch } from 'paperpop';

components.name: Select
components.description: Custom dropdown with full keyboard support (arrows, Home/End, Enter, Escape, type-ahead) on top of a native select.
components.notes: A hidden native `<select>` stays underneath, so `value`, `onChange`, `name`, `required` and form submission work as usual.
components.example:
import { Select } from 'paperpop';

<Select placeholder="Kategorie wählen" options={['Allgemein', 'Hilfe', 'Show & Tell']} />

props.name: options
props.description: Options as values or { value, label }. Alternatively pass <option> children.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown as a disabled first option.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Range slider with a washi tape fill and a value tag.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value in a little tag next to the slider.

components.name: SearchInput
components.description: Rounded search field with icon, clear button and shortcut hint.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shows a keyboard hint like "/" on the right.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Heart or star rating - interactive or read-only.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new rating. Omit for a read-only display.

components.name: FileDrop
components.description: Dashed drop zone: click or drag files onto it, chosen files appear as removable previews.
components.example:
import { FileDrop } from 'paperpop';

<FileDrop accept="image/*" multiple onFiles={(files) => console.log(files)} />

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the chosen or dropped files.

props.name: accept
props.description: accept attribute of the hidden input, e.g. "image/*".

components.name: NumberStepper
components.description: Minus / value / plus for quantities - click the number to type one.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Taped-on note for info, success, warning and error messages - optionally closable.
components.example:
import { Alert } from 'paperpop';
Das Formular lädt Turnstile erst nach deiner Zustimmung. {}} /> Noch 2 von 50 Plätzen frei. Versuch es gleich nochmal oder schreib mir direkt.

props.name: status
props.description: Kind of message; sets colour and icon.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button that calls this.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Little notes that slide in from the corner. Wrap the app in ToastProvider, then call useToast().

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small counters and status labels, with dot and pulsing "live" variants.
components.example:
import { Badge } from 'paperpop';
3 neu 99+ beta live

props.name: dot
props.description: Just a small dot, no text.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Chips for tags, filters and categories - optionally with icon and remove button.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Progress bar filled with rolling washi tape, or indeterminate while loading.
components.example: import { Progress } from 'paperpop';

props.name: value
props.description: 0 - 100. Leave undefined for an indeterminate bar.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage on the right.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Three twinkling sparkles circling - the loading indicator.
components.example: import { Spinner } from 'paperpop';

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text next to the spinner, also used as the accessible label.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Shimmering placeholders while content loads.
components.example: import { Skeleton } from 'paperpop';

props.name: lines
props.description: Render n text lines instead of one block.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Tiny sticky-note tooltip on hover and keyboard focus.
components.example:
import { Pill, Tooltip } from 'paperpop';
Drüberfahren Unten

components.name: Modal
components.description: A paper sheet dropping onto a dimmed page. Escape and backdrop close it.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on backdrop click, Escape or the close button.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Friendly "nothing here yet" block for empty lists, inboxes and search results.
components.example:
import { Button, EmptyState } from 'paperpop';

<EmptyState icon="mail" title="Noch keine Nachrichten" action={<Button size="sm" color="butter">Erste schreiben</Button>}>
  Sobald dir jemand schreibt, landet es hier. Versprochen.
</EmptyState>

components.name: ConsentBanner
components.description: Cookie/consent sticky note in the corner with a dimmed page - you decide where the choice is stored.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Dim the page behind the banner.

props.name: status
props.description: Small line under the buttons, e.g. the current choice.

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Top bar with brand and pill links; turns into a menu button on phones.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand text ("jack"). A pink dot is added after it.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra content on the right (buttons, avatar).

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stick to the top while scrolling.

props.name: collapse
props.description: Fold the links into a menu button on phones. With false the pills just wrap.

props.name: back
props.description: Sub-page mode: a back pill on the left, the brand moves to the right.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Torn footer strip with brand, note, legal links and a scissors cut line above.

props.name: brand
props.description: Big brand word on the left.

props.name: links
props.description: Small links (Impressum, Datenschutz …); entries without href become buttons.

props.name: cutline
props.description: Draw a scissors cut line above the footer.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Folder-style index tabs sticking out of a card; arrow keys switch.

props.name: value
props.description: Active tab id (controlled). Leave undefined for uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new tab id.

props.name: colorful
props.description: Folder tab colours cycle through the palette.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Folding strips for FAQs and settings groups.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Path navigation with handwritten arrows; the current page gets a label.
components.example:
import { Breadcrumbs } from 'paperpop';

<Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: 'Forum', href: '/forum' }, { label: 'Hilfe', href: '/forum/help' }, { label: 'Server startet nicht' }]} />

props.name: items
props.description: Path items; the last one is the current page.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page numbers as crooked paper squares with prev/next arrows.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Vertical app navigation with sections, icons, badges and a footer.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content pinned to the bottom (user, logout).

components.name: Menu
components.description: Dropdown menu on a paper card - keyboard navigation (arrows, Home/End, type-ahead), closes on outside click and Escape.
components.example:
import { Menu } from 'paperpop';

<Menu trigger="Aktionen" items={[
  { label: 'Bearbeiten', icon: 'pen' },
  { label: 'Teilen', icon: 'link' },
  { label: 'Anpinnen', icon: 'pin' },
  { label: 'Löschen', icon: 'trash', danger: true, divider: true },
]} />

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge the menu aligns to.

props.name: iconTrigger
props.description: Render the trigger as a round icon button.

components.name: Steps
components.description: Numbered torn cards in a row - "how it works" sections. They fly in one after another on scroll.
components.example:
import { Steps } from 'paperpop';

<Steps items={[
  { title: 'Repo anlegen', text: 'Template nutzen, fertig.' },
  { title: 'Komponenten wählen', text: 'Alles liegt in Paper Pop.' },
  { title: 'Seite bauen', text: 'Zusammenstecken wie Lego.' },
  { title: 'Pushen', text: 'Der Runner deployt.' },
]} />

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ title: ReactNode; text?: ReactNode; color?: PaperColor; edge?: TornEdge; tilt?: number }>
props.description: Steps with a handwritten title and text; colour, edge and tilt vary automatically unless set.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Vertical timeline with a dashed line and pastel dots.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ date: ReactNode; title: ReactNode; text?: ReactNode; color?: PaperColor; icon?: IconName }>
props.description: Entries, newest first or oldest first - your call.

components.name: Container
components.description: Centered page column (max 1280px) with a 16px gutter on phones.
components.example:
import { Container } from 'paperpop';

<Container max={600} style={{ outline: '2px dashed var(--pp-pink)', padding: 20 }}>
  Alles, was hier drin ist, bleibt schön mittig und maximal 600px breit.
</Container>

components.name: Section
components.description: Page section with kicker, big heading, intro and an aside slot - consistent spacing.
components.example:

<Section space="sm" kicker="was ich so baue" title="Projekte" intro="Ein paar Dinge, auf die ich stolz bin." aside={<Pill href="#all">alle ansehen →</Pill>} style={{ padding: 0 }}>
  <Paper color="mint" edge="card-1">Inhalt der Section</Paper>
</Section>

props.name: aside
props.description: Content on the right side of the heading row (links, buttons).

components.name: Stack
components.description: Flexbox helper for vertical or horizontal stacks with a gap.
components.example: import { Badge, Pill, Stack } from 'paperpop'; einszweidrei Linksrechts

components.name: Grid
components.description: Responsive grid: fixed columns that collapse on small screens, or auto-fit by min width.

props.name: cols
props.description: Fixed number of columns, or omit and use `min` for auto-fit.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum column width for auto-fit (number = px).

components.name: Card
components.description: Ink-bordered card with a hard shadow for UI - title, eyebrow, actions, footer, hover lift.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small caps line above the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: Content in the top right (menu, badge).

props.name: hover
props.description: Lift and straighten on hover (for clickable cards).

components.name: Divider
components.description: Horizontal divider: dashed, squiggly or a strip of washi tape, with optional label.
components.example: import { Divider } from 'paperpop';

components.name: StatCard
components.description: KPI card: label, counting number, delta arrow, icon and sparkline.

props.name: delta

props.name: color
props.description: Accent colour for the icon badge.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: Tiny inline trend line for cards and tables.

props.name: color
props.description: Line colour (palette name or CSS colour).

props.name: area
props.description: Soft area fill under the line.

components.name: BarChart

`${v}%`} />

components.name: DonutChart

components.name: ProgressRing
components.description: Circular progress for goals and quotas in three sizes.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: Sortable table with sticky header, zebra rows, custom cells and an empty state.

components.name: Avatar

props.name: color

components.name: ActivityFeed

components.name: CountUp

components.description: Big torn title sheet with kicker, lead and buttons next to a taped polaroid.

props.name: media

props.description: id for the title, e.g. to point aria-labelledby at it.

props.name: children

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.description: Grid of torn feature cards with icon stickers, alternating colours and tilts.

props.name: items
props.description: Features. Colours and tilts vary automatically.

components.name: PricingTable
components.description: Pricing plans side by side; the featured one gets a sticker and a bigger shadow.

components.name: Testimonial
components.description: Quote on a taped note with a mini polaroid of the author.
components.example:
import { Testimonial } from 'paperpop';

<Testimonial quote="Jack ist ein richtig guter und netter Chef 😂" name="Boby" role="Mod" />

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL - shown as a mini polaroid.

components.name: CtaBanner

components.name: Newsletter
components.description: E-mail signup card with airmail stripes and a success stamp.
components.example:
import { Newsletter } from 'paperpop';

<Newsletter text="Einmal im Monat, was ich gebaut habe. Kein Spam." onSubscribe={async (email) => { console.log(email); }} />

props.name: onSubscribe
props.description: Called with the e-mail address. Throw to show `errorText`.

components.name: PolaroidStack
components.description: A pile of polaroids that fans out on hover (on scroll into view on touch devices).

props.name: hint
props.description: Handwritten hint under the closed stack.

props.name: width
props.description: Polaroid width in px at every size. Leave empty for the responsive default (230 / 190 / 170 / 150 px).

components.name: Marquee
components.description: Endless strip of tape with scrolling words - between sections or as a ticker.
components.example: import { Marquee } from 'paperpop';

props.name: items
props.description: Items that scroll by, separated by sparkles.

components.name: LinkCard
components.description: Link-in-bio row on a torn card with icon, title and subtitle - links, external profiles or copy-a-username.
components.example: import { LinkCard } from 'paperpop';

props.name: action
props.default: '→' ('↗' for external links, '⧉' for copy cards)

props.name: copyText
props.description: Copy this text to the clipboard instead of navigating (for Discord/Signal names).

components.name: LogoCloud
components.description: "Known from" row with image logos or label-maker text tags.
components.example:
import { LogoCloud } from 'paperpop';

<LogoCloud logos={[{ name: 'Minecraft' }, { name: 'GitHub' }, { name: 'Discord' }, { name: 'Docker' }]} />

props.name: logos
props.description: Logos: image URLs or text names (rendered as label-maker tags).

components.name: ThreadCard
components.description: Forum thread in a list: votes, category, title, excerpt, tags, participants and counters.
components.example: import { ThreadCard } from 'paperpop';

props.name: excerpt
props.description: Short preview of the first post.

props.name: score
props.description: Vote score - shows a vote column when set.

components.name: Post
components.description: Full forum post with author header, role badge, body, reactions and actions; can be marked as best answer.

components.name: Comment
components.description: Threaded comments with a dashed reply line - nest Comments as children.
components.example:
import { Comment } from 'paperpop';

<Comment author="Kim" time="vor 1 Std." text="Hat bei mir auch geholfen, danke!" likes={3} onReply={() => {}} op>
  <Comment author="Boby" time="vor 50 Min." text="Gern! Sag Bescheid, wenn noch was ist." likes={1} onReply={() => {}}>
    <Comment author="Kim" time="vor 45 Min." text="Läuft alles ♥" op />
  </Comment>
</Comment>

props.name: op
props.description: Mark comments by the thread author.

components.name: VoteButtons
components.description: Up/down voting with a bouncy score, vertical or horizontal.
components.example: import { VoteButtons } from 'paperpop';

props.name: score
props.description: Score before the user's own vote.

props.name: vote
props.description: The user's vote (controlled). Leave undefined to let the component manage it.

components.name: Reactions
components.description: Toggleable reaction chips with counts.
components.example:
import { Reactions } from 'paperpop';

<Reactions items={[
  { icon: 'heart', label: 'Herz', count: 12, active: true },
  { icon: 'fire', label: 'Feuer', count: 4 },
  { icon: 'thumbs-up', label: 'Daumen', count: 9 },
  { icon: 'sparkle', label: 'Glitzer', count: 1 },
]} />

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called with the toggled reaction label and new state.

components.name: Composer
components.description: Reply box with live markdown formatting, toolbar, preview, character counter and send button.
components.notes: While you type, `**bold**`, `_italic_`, `` `code` `` and `[links](https://)` are formatted in place with the markers greyed out. The toolbar (and Ctrl/Cmd+B, Ctrl/Cmd+I) wraps the selection and keeps the cursor in the box so you can carry on typing; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends. The eye button shows the finished result.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the text. The box clears afterwards.

components.name: UserCard
components.description: Profile card with polaroid avatar, badges, bio, stats and actions.

components.name: CategoryCard
components.description: Board/category tile with icon, description and thread/post counters.
components.example: import { CategoryCard } from 'paperpop';

components.name: AppShell

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Left navigation, usually a <Sidebar>. Hidden behind a menu button on small screens.

components.name: ChatThread
components.description: Chat with grouped bubbles, typing indicator and input row. In this demo Kim and Boby answer whatever you send.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called when the user sends a message. Omit to hide the input.

props.name: compact
props.description: Hide avatar and name (for consecutive messages).

components.name: KanbanBoard
components.description: Drag-and-drop board of sticky notes in columns.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the updated columns after a card was dragged to another column.

components.name: MiniCalendar
components.description: Month calendar on a tear-off pad with selected day, today marker and event dots. Click the month to jump to any month and year.
components.notes: In the month picker you can type the year, use the arrow keys or scroll with the mouse wheel.

components.name: Checklist
components.description: To-do list on a sticky note - tick items off, optionally add new ones.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Keyboard key caps for shortcuts.
components.example:
import { Kbd } from 'paperpop';

Suche öffnen mit oder einfach .

props.name: keys
props.description: Keys, e.g. ['⌘', 'K']. Strings render a single key.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Code snippet with file tab and copy button - language is detected automatically, 20 languages in 8 colour styles.
components.notes: Leave `language` on "auto" and the block detects TypeScript/JSX, JSON, HTML, CSS, shell, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C#, C/C++, PHP, Ruby, SQL, YAML, TOML, Markdown, diff and Dockerfile; aliases such as `ts`, `sh`, `yml` also work. `theme` is `ink` (dark, default), `paper`, `pink`, `butter`, `mint`, `sky`, `lilac` or `auto` (follows the system light/dark setting).
components.example:
import { Button, CodeBlock } from 'paperpop';
alert(42)}>{label};\n}'} /> =22" } }'} />

props.name: title
props.description: Label in the tab (file name or language). Defaults to the language.

props.name: language
props.description: Language for highlighting. "auto" detects it from the code; common names and aliases (ts, tsx, sh, yml, c++ ...) work.

props.name: theme
props.description: Colour style. "ink" is dark, the pastels are light, "auto" follows the system light/dark setting.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A sheet of paper sliding in from the side - filters, details, settings.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on backdrop click, Escape or the close button.
